why: The element that had focus was just removed from the document, which leaves focus on <body> and a keyboard or controller player with nowhere to go but Tab from the top of a page whose only control is the one they need. The button is still reachable, so this is a degradation rather than a dead end -- which is exactly why nothing but an explicit activeElement assertion catches it.
